raceTips.comment: STAR OF JAMAICA returns and has been gelded since we last saw him on raceday. He brings the strongest formlines into this race and looks ready to fire off a recent trial win. BOONIE BOOM showed good early speed to take up the running from the outside draw on debut and gave a good kick late to get the job done. She’ll be better for the experience and can go on with it. TOUCH BASE kicked off his campaign with a dominant four length victory over 870m at Toowoomba. He strips fitter, the slight rise in trip will suit and he draws well. QUEEN OLYMPIAS just found better on debut over the 800m at Ipswich but showed plenty of tenacity last start to hold off the challengers over 1000m at the Gold Coast. This is tougher but she draws low and will be in it for a long way.
